title: Gemini CLI retired in intent but still active in Plans; Antigravity replacement is missing
impact: Provider registry, auth, model selection, media, setup/health, usage, orchestration, and GUI identity would implement a dead provider while missing its replacement.
required_repair: Remove Gemini CLI from active provider canon and add Antigravity as a concrete provider with auth, launcher, model discovery, account isolation, thinking effort, media support, setup/health, usage/quota, errors, and E2E validation.

title: Provider-entry inventory conflicts with first-class direct coding-plan providers
impact: Settings provider lists, setup flows, account profiles, quota display, model pickers, and dispatch validation cannot share a single provider registry.
required_repair: Make Multi-Account the provider-entry inventory owner and replace exactly-seven canon with current provider taxonomy and readiness states.

title: Cursor route strategy is stale and split across incompatible CLI/API assumptions
impact: Cursor cannot be implemented as a single predictable provider route, and the GUI cannot reliably explain auth/model/media behavior.
required_repair: Choose Cursor direct API/composer, ACP, CLI bridge, or a phased route; then align setup, usage, account, model, media, errors, and GUI copy.

title: Media support is stale, Gemini-centered, and cannot express current provider capabilities
impact: The media API and GUI setup flow cannot represent provider/model media support beyond Gemini/Cursor, including newer OpenAI image generation or provider-specific multimodal support.
required_repair: Create a provider-model-media matrix and replace the backend enum with a richer provider/model/runtime/auth route shape.

title: OpenCode route, identity, and readiness contracts remain internally inconsistent
impact: OpenCode could pass catalog/connected checks while failing actual prompt execution, and implementers may follow stale identity or route assumptions.
required_repair: Verify and pin current OpenCode repo/API/version, add fixtures for server routes and SSE events, and split catalog/auth/E2E/usable readiness.

title: BinaryLocator/setup health does not cover the actual provider launcher surface
impact: Setup UI and Doctor cannot validate Antigravity, OpenCode launcher/server profiles, or other CLI/server-backed providers with deterministic probes.
required_repair: Add concrete provider-owned launcher metadata: binary names, paths, version commands, auth probes, wrong-binary signatures, and remediation copy.

title: Provider/model selection and capability APIs have competing contracts
impact: Different doc sections produce different effective provider/model/capability outcomes.
required_repair: Make Models_System the sole resolver owner, update GUI consumers to account-bound provider/model profiles, and use the caller-scoped capability response everywhere.

title: Direct coding-plan provider coverage is not ready for first-class implementation
impact: Alibaba/Qwen, MiniMax, Z.AI/GLM, Kimi/Moonshot, and related direct providers lack enough verified provider IDs, auth, model, usage, quota, media, and E2E proof.
required_repair: Define per-provider readiness and require primary-source plus local E2E evidence before promotion.

title: Thinking effort selection is not consistently provider/model scoped
impact: A global thinking-effort UI could expose unsupported settings or hide supported ones because capability mapping is provider-specific and stale.
required_repair: Define normalized thinking effort with provider/model capability flags, mappings, clamping, inheritance, GUI disabled states, and validation.

title: Usage/rate-limit provider surfaces have stale or incomplete currentness
impact: Usage UI can mislabel missing usage, poll unsafe sources, omit newer rate-limit signals, or preserve retired Gemini CLI usage paths.
required_repair: Add per-provider usage source contracts, freshness labels, refresh limits, missing-vs-zero fixtures, and current rate-limit source reconciliation.

title: Provider-native tool and permission boundaries are too permissive or ambiguous
impact: Provider-native tools or shell-like command behavior could bypass PM permission mediation or mishandle secret custody.
required_repair: Require PM mediation for provider-native tools, prohibit raw secret persistence, separate preview/execute behavior, and define MVP custom-tool sandboxing.

title: Runtime artifact/provider-native artifact coverage and schemas are incomplete
impact: Artifact panel and provider receipts cannot be implemented consistently for current providers if schema files and mappings are missing.
required_repair: Add or locate provider-neutral runtime artifact envelope/schema files and provider-native artifact mappings for current providers.

title: Stubs, stale anchors, and compatibility-only language are still easy to implement accidentally
impact: Implementers could rebuild retired Gemini CLI or old Rust/Iced platform_specs behavior from active-looking text.
required_repair: Move stale tokens to lineage-only notes, replace legacy anchors with current owner contracts, and remove live GUI-facing Gemini CLI examples.
